title: Jacket, sweater, shoes
hook: You'll want the jacket first. Where in the bag should it go?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: that a bag opened from the top gives items back in the reverse order of packing, so the item you need first should be packed last

misconception: Pack things in the order you will use them, first-needed first.
objective: A bag that opens at the top gives back the last thing packed first. So pack in reverse: what you need last goes in first, and the jacket you need first goes in last, on top.
